title: Acer Nitro KG271X1 27" FHD IPS 200Hz 1ms Gaming Monitor $99 + Delivery ($0 VIC, NSW, QLD C&C/ in-Store) @ Centre Com
body:
Deal: Acer Nitro KG271X1 27" FHD IPS 200Hz 1ms Gaming Monitor $99 + Delivery ($0 VIC, NSW, QLD C&C/ in-Store) @ Centre Com

[Rivet] It's $99. Were you expecting a 4K OLED for that price?
[Clear] My very unpopular opinion is that I like 27" at FHD (not for gaming).
[Rivet] Might not be popular, but it's valid, especially when HiDPI scaling is still quite buggy sometimes. For me, this would have been perfect for my NAS, but delivery to regional QLD is nearly $42 unfortunately.
[boozed] My work-issued monitors are 27" FHD and they're just fine
[neonlight] Great for working from home though. Too bad the stand is bottom only
[Clear] @neonlight: Supports VESA mounting at least
[MrZ] IPS
insert vomit emoji here. VA so much better. IPS can't do decent blacks and almost all LED TVs use VA panels.
[netsurfer] For monitors, you generally prefer IPS over VA (Apple use IPS for their Mini LED displays on Macbook Pros, people don't whinge about that). If you have the budget, QD-OLED monitors.
Text, gaming, and viewing angle, IPS is better. If VA is better for monitors, most monitor makers would be selling them (VA panels are cheaper to make). Think about it, if VA is so great, why wouldn't Apple use it? VA is making a big comeback through TVs because of HDR. Gaming on VA isn't great to be honest.
With your VA based TV(s), do a simple tapping test, you see ripples when you tap the display. That's why you don't see VA panels used on mobile phones.
[MrZ] Apple don't use VA because Apples are popular with people who work in photography and so forth. For the majority of people, VA is better. Why are you viewing your monitor from a non-optimal angle? Viewing normally, no issues with VA.
[dsiritz] Have played competitive games on my 27in 280hz monitor for many years now and initially I didn’t like the slight downgrade in quality from 24in though that quickly went away. Paid around $400 from memory so this looks incredible.
[jimmykim] i have one of these for my work monitor and it serves me well; i can see Teams screen and numbers in Excel well.
[schquid] Do they offer a version that lets me see Excel but sends Teams to the depths of hell where it belongs?
[canihabdiscountspls] Used fhd for years, qhd is really good, can fit so much in the screen.
